## Goal

Make "won a game" a first-class, engine-generic achievement event so the give-away triggers have a real, Steam-free source.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AchievementSystem` (or a documented thin extension) gains an idempotent game-outcome surface (e.g. `onGameOutcome({ gameId, outcome })`) that unlocks mapped achievements via the existing `AchievementSink`; zero Steam/Electron imports.
- The launcher manifest defines `first-win` and `second-distinct-game-win` meta-achievements (titles, descriptions, hidden flags) and the outcome-to-achievement mapping is engine-generic.
- "Second distinct game" logic only unlocks after wins in two different game ids; re-wins of the same game do not.
- `SteamAchievementService` idempotence and offline paths are reused unchanged for the meta-achievements.
- Unit tests cover outcome-to-unlock, distinct-game counting, idempotence, and no-op for unknown outcomes; pass under `--project unit`.

## Key Files

- `src/core-engine/AchievementSystem.ts`
- `src/core-engine/index.ts`
- `electron/achievement-manifest.json`
- `tests/steam-achievements/achievement-outcome.test.ts` (new)

## Deliverables

Engine outcome surface, manifest meta-achievements, unit tests.
data.title: Engine game-outcome surface and cross-game meta-achievements

# Goal

As a downstream game-repo maintainer, I want a freshly scaffolded (or
re-scaffolded) launcher to boot `Phaser.AUTO` — so a generated repo does not
silently regress to Canvas and lose Phaser 4's Filter/GPU-shader pipeline.

Producer decision (2026-10-29): **flip both** the scaffold and the core repo's
own `main.ts` in this item.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Scaffold emits `Phaser.AUTO`.** `scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts`
  `renderMainTs()` emits `type: Phaser.AUTO`, the core repo's own `main.ts`
  matches, and any scaffold test asserting `Phaser.CANVAS` is updated.
- `scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts` `renderMainTs()` emits `type: Phaser.AUTO`.
- The core repo's `main.ts` boots `type: Phaser.AUTO` (it currently emits
  `Phaser.CANVAS` at the `createCardGame` call).
- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts` asserts the generated `main.ts`
  contains `Phaser.AUTO` and contains **no** `Phaser.CANVAS`, replacing any
  `Phaser.CANVAS` expectation.
- `src/core-engine/TestGamePool.ts` and browser-test harnesses stay
  `Phaser.CANVAS` (CI speed under SwiftShader) — asserted by a test so a later
  "unification" cannot quietly force WebGL in tests.
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` and `docs/dev/creating-a-new-game.md` state the renderer
  the scaffold emits and why (`AUTO` = WebGL with Canvas fallback).
- `npm run build`, unit tests and the game-discovery/scaffold unit tests green.
- Reasoned evidence recorded in a comment: core launcher WebGL boot verified
  locally after the clip children land (`npm run dev`, no unclipped overlay, no
  `setMask` warning in the console).

## Key Files

- `scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts`
- `main.ts`
- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts`
- `src/core-engine/TestGamePool.ts`
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md`
- `docs/dev/creating-a-new-game.md`

## Dependencies

- Blocked-by `CG-0MVTQ3VL4002RB1D` (core panels) and `CG-0MVTQ3W58004XN92` (Gym scene): shipping a WebGL default is
  only safe once every core-owned clip is renderer-aware.

## Deliverables

- Scaffold + launcher on `AUTO`, tests and docs updated.
data.title: Scaffold and core launcher emit Phaser.AUTO

# Goal

As the Main Street repo maintainer, I want the satisfying core commit, the
re-pin steps and the acceptance signal handed to the existing follow-up item, so
the downstream switch-over is unambiguous.

Producer decision (2026-10-29): **single source of truth** — Main Street should
delete its local `src/ContainerClip.ts` and import the core helper.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Downstream switch-over hand-off.** On completion, a work item is created (or
  the existing placeholder updated) in the Main Street repo (`../tce-main-street`)
  to bump the pinned core commit in `configs/engine-pin.json`, run
  `npm run scaffold` to regenerate `main.ts`, re-run
  `tests/main-street/webgl-renderer-clipping.browser.test.ts` with the
  core-owned warnings no longer excluded, and confirm the launcher boots WebGL
  with no unclipped core overlay. The existing placeholder
  `MS-0MVTMJ2GA008GRZ7` is updated, not duplicated.
- `MS-0MVTMJ2GA008GRZ7` (Main Street store, currently `blocked`) receives a
  comment naming the core commit that satisfies this item and listing the exact
  steps: re-pin `configs/engine-pin.json`, `npm run scaffold` to regenerate
  `main.ts` as `Phaser.AUTO`, replace the local `src/ContainerClip.ts` with the
  core `@ui/ContainerClip` import and delete the local copy, then re-run
  `tests/main-street/webgl-renderer-clipping.browser.test.ts` with the
  core-originated warnings **no longer excluded**.
- The comment states the acceptance signal: launcher boots WebGL, no
  `setMask … not supported in WebGL` warning, no unclipped core overlay.
- The comment is left with `wl --worklog-dir ../tce-main-street/.worklog …`;
  **no code, config or test file in `../tce-main-street` is edited** by this item.
- Any residual Main Street risk is captured (e.g. filter cost measured while
  keeping the local copy for comparison).
- A note is left on `MS-0MVTE0UP00013TNW` that its scope landed here via
  `CG-0MVTMITW7002VF0I`.

## Key Files

- `../tce-main-street/configs/engine-pin.json`
- `../tce-main-street/src/ContainerClip.ts`

## Dependencies

- Blocked-by `CG-0MVTQ3WPV003ZECA` (scaffold + launcher emit `Phaser.AUTO`).

## Deliverables

- Cross-repo comments on `MS-0MVTMJ2GA008GRZ7` and `MS-0MVTE0UP00013TNW`.
data.title: Main Street hand-off: re-pin core, re-scaffold AUTO, verify clean WebGL boot

# Goal

As a maintainer, I want tests that only encoded the old GeometryMask/Canvas
assumptions removed or rewritten, so the suite asserts behaviour instead of the
implementation we just replaced.

Producer decision (2026-10-29): create an explicit work item for deleting the
obsolete tests rather than doing it ad hoc inside the migration children.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every test that asserts `GeometryMask` construction/`setMask` internals on the
  migrated sites is either deleted or rewritten to assert clipping behaviour
  (pixel/probe or helper-spy), with a one-line reason in the commit message:
  - `tests/ui/HelpSettingsButtons.test.ts`
  - `tests/ui/Overlay.test.ts`
  - `tests/ui/SettingsPanel.test.ts`
  - `tests/ui/SettingsPanel*.browser.test.ts`
  - `tests/gym/GymOverlayUiScene.browser.test.ts` (if any GeometryMask regex
    assertions remain)
  - `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts` (`Phaser.CANVAS` expectations)
- No surviving test asserts on `new Phaser.Display.Masks.GeometryMask` in the
  four migrated sites; a `grep`-style guard test is **not** added (source-grep
  tests are a documented low-value anti-pattern — see
  `docs/dev/test-suite-review.md`).
- Coverage is not lost: each deleted assertion's behaviour is covered by a
  replacement behavioural assertion (cross-referenced in the commit message).
- `npx vitest run --project unit tests/ui/ tests/scripts/` and the affected
  browser files are green.

## Key Files

- `tests/ui/HelpSettingsButtons.test.ts`
- `tests/ui/Overlay.test.ts`
- `tests/ui/SettingsPanel.test.ts`
- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts`
- `docs/dev/test-suite-review.md`

## Dependencies

- Blocked-by `CG-0MVTQ3VL4002RB1D`, `CG-0MVTQ3W58004XN92` and `CG-0MVTQ3WPV003ZECA` — prune only
  what they obsolete.

## Deliverables

- Pruned/rewritten tests + commit message listing each removal and its
  replacement coverage.

data.comment:
Implementation complete (cb7e09c6).

**Changes**
- `scripts/game-repo-scaffold.ts` `renderMainTs()` now emits `type: Phaser.AUTO`; the core repo's own `main.ts` matches (both carry a comment explaining AUTO = WebGL with Canvas fallback).
- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts`: new `renderMainTs` suite asserts the template contains `type: Phaser.AUTO` and no `Phaser.CANVAS`, plus an on-disk assertion on the scaffolded `main.ts`.
- `src/core-engine/TestGamePool.ts`: the Canvas pin is now real code, not just a doc claim — exported `TEST_RENDER_TYPE` (= `Phaser.CANVAS`) and `withTestRenderer(options)` which replaces any caller-supplied `AUTO`/`WEBGL`.
- `tests/core-engine/TestGamePool.test.ts` (new): asserts the pin (not AUTO, not WEBGL) and that `withTestRenderer` overrides an AUTO/WEBGL request.
- `tests/ui/createCardGame.test.ts`: asserts the default is `Phaser.AUTO` and that an explicit `Phaser.CANVAS` override (what browser harnesses pass) still reaches the Phaser config.
- Docs: `docs/DEVELOPER.md` (new 'Renderer the scaffold emits' subsection) and `docs/dev/creating-a-new-game.md` state the emitted renderer and why, plus the tests-are-Canvas exception and the `bootRendererScene.ts` opt-in path for GPU tests.

**Evidence (AC7)**
- Full suite green at the pushed commit (test-skill cached run, `npm --silent test`, scope full): unit 232 files / 3633 tests passed; browser 41 files / 264 tests passed; tutorial E2E parts skipped (no `tce-main-street` sibling in this checkout).
- WebGL boot evidence is machine-checked rather than visual: `tests/ui/CorePanelWebglClip.browser.test.ts` (4 tests, green in that run) boots `Phaser.WEBGL` through `bootRendererScene` and asserts the requested WebGL renderer is actually created and that **no** `setMask … not supported in WebGL` warning is emitted for the HelpPanel/Overlay/SettingsPanel scroll clips — i.e. the clip children landed (`ContainerClip` Mask-filter path) and the panels render clipped under WebGL.
- Static cross-check: the only remaining `setMask` calls in `src/` are inside `ContainerClip`'s Canvas branch; `example-games/` has none.
- Limitation/assumption: no agent-side interactive `npm run dev` visual session was run (no GUI in this environment). The WebGL parity suite above is the programmatic equivalent of the requested 'no unclipped overlay, no setMask warning' check; a human operator may still do the visual pass.

`CG-0MVTMITW7002VF0I` is delivered on core `dev`; the satisfying commit is
**`cb7e09c6` (`cb7e09c6bc6e6a6ded671f93a624b638ae20c623`)**, the current
`origin/dev` tip:

| Commit | Item | Delivers |
|---|---|---|
| `4ee3d474` | `CG-0MVTQ3UFI009LH8Q` | renderer-parity browser harness |
| `da834259` | `CG-0MVTQ3UZL004YO8O` | `src/ui/ContainerClip.ts` + `@ui` export |
| `5f96911d` | `CG-0MVTQ3VL4002RB1D` | `HelpPanel` / `Overlay` / `SettingsPanel` migrated |
| `45a19738` | `CG-0MVTQ3W58004XN92` | `GymOverlayUiScene` migrated |
| `cb7e09c6` | `CG-0MVTQ3WPV003ZECA` | scaffold + core `main.ts` emit `Phaser.AUTO` |

## What was written

1. **`MS-0MVTMJ2GA008GRZ7`** (the existing placeholder — updated, not
   duplicated): comment id `MS-C0MVUJ57SU001QA7U`. It names the delivering core
   commit, the five-commit chain, the read-only verification table (helper
   present + exported; `setMask` only on `ContainerClip`'s Canvas branch; no
   `GeometryMask` construction left in the four sites; both generators emit
   `Phaser.AUTO`), the **exact steps** (re-pin `configs/engine-pin.json` and run
   `npm run engine:check`; `npm run scaffold` + idempotence check; adopt
   `@ui/ContainerClip` and delete the local `src/ContainerClip.ts` with the four
   call sites listed; remove the core-path exclusion from
   `inRepoCanvasOnlyWarnings()` in
   `tests/main-street/webgl-renderer-clipping.browser.test.ts`; verify build /
   WebGL test / full suite / manual smoke), the **acceptance signal** (WebGL
   renderer, zero `setMask … not supported in WebGL` warnings from any source,
   no unclipped core overlay), and the residual risks.
2. **`MS-0MVTE0UP00013TNW`** (the earlier core-deferral record): comment id
   `MS-C0MVUJ5NWX009IIZN`, recording that its scope landed here via
   `CG-0MVTMITW7002VF0I` at `cb7e09c6`, that `MS-0MVTMJ2GA008GRZ7` carries the
   switch-over, and that the stale deferral notes are retired there.
3. Removed the now-false `cross-repo-blocked` tag from
   `MS-0MVTMJ2GA008GRZ7` (its prerequisite is delivered); status/stage were left
   for the Main Street side (`open` / `plan_complete`; child 1
   `MS-0MVU03TF9003W55I` is the startable leaf).

Both comments were written with
`wl --worklog-dir ../tce-main-street/.worklog comment add … --author implement`.

## Scope confirmation

- **No file in `../tce-main-street` was edited** — `git status --porcelain` in
  that checkout is empty (its `.worklog/` is gitignored), so no code, config or
  test change came from this item.
- No file in this core repo changed either: this is a work-item-only (chore)
  item, so its completion has no code diff.

## Residual Main Street risk (carried into `MS-0MVTMJ2GA008GRZ7`)

- **Filter cost:** the core helper is mechanically the same as the local copy
  (diff is docs/typing only), so per-clip Mask-filter cost is unchanged for Main
  Street's three clips; the three core-owned scroll surfaces now add a filter
  step each where they previously rendered unclipped under WebGL. A measured
  regression should become its own Main Street item — the single-source-of-truth
  decision (delete the local copy) stands.
- **Scaffold overwrite:** `npm run scaffold` replaces `main.ts` wholesale, so
  the hand-written renderer commentary is replaced by the generated header by
  design.
- **Two core children remain open** (`CG-0MVTQ3XAE0061ETN` docs,
  `CG-0MVTQ3YJ2004QWDJ` prune obsolete tests). Both are docs/test-only with no
  engine behaviour change, so pinning `cb7e09c6` is safe; a later one-line
  re-pin is optional.
